description: This file defines classes and methods for executing SQL queries in JSON format within the Superset project, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous execution modes, with error handling, timeout management, and integration with Celery workers.

classes.name: SqlJsonExecutor
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the execute method for SQL JSON execution.

classes.name: SqlJsonExecutorBase
classes.description: Base class implementing common properties for SQL JSON executors, including DAO and task references.

classes.name: SynchronousSqlJsonExecutor
classes.description: Implements synchronous SQL JSON execution with timeout and error handling.

classes.name: ASynchronousSqlJsonExecutor
classes.description: Implements asynchronous SQL JSON execution using Celery workers, with error handling.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL JSON query, either synchronously or asynchronously, handling errors and timeouts.

methods.name: _get_sql_results_with_timeout
methods.description: Retrieves SQL results with a timeout context.

methods.name: _get_sql_results
methods.description: Calls the task to get SQL results.

methods.name: _is_store_results
methods.description: Determines whether to store results based on configuration and context.
